filterAssertions.name: OR within dynasty; AND with role-tagged contributor and script
Zero matches is distinct from unsupplied metadata

supportingScenarios.description: 创建三个公开根评论：两个同点赞数，按较新创建时间和稳定 ID 破同分；一个零点赞。回复点赞不增加根热度。执行点赞/取消后核对顺序、计数与分页不重复。
作者自己的待审根、隐藏根和对应回复保留完整原文；作者可回复自己的非公开根。访客和匿名上下文均不可见，也不进入公开热度与统计。
分别创建有跨作者回复的公开线程：删除正文保留其他合格回复与必要占位；移除整线程后所有作者的 My Comments 都不可恢复该上下文。两种操作需要独立确认和审计。

versions.title: 合成编辑草稿乙
versions.text: 第二个独立登录上下文的较新文字，应用另一版本不能删除本段。

supportingScenarios.description: 在两个独立认证浏览器上下文保存相同基线的不同版本，显示冲突与可恢复版本。应用选择的版本后，未选文字保留，作品身份和首次发布时间不变。

seedingInstructions: This is a frozen private input manifest, not authorization to publish or mutate a database.
A later explicitly authorized task seed must verify the task-owned container/system identity and database/role before any write.
Do not run the older four-Catalog community acceptance seed in addition to these ten Catalogs.
Use Payload native owner-context creation and media upload for Catalog records; register returned immutable media metadata before embedding snapshots.
Use Backend-owned user media and narrowly guarded synthetic creation of the ten already-existing works; never add a public work-creation UI.
Treat discoveryFacts as proposed task fixture inputs for the approved normalized-filter implementation, not as fields accepted by the old Payload schema.
Apply intendedFirstPublishedAt only through an explicitly supported synthetic fixture/migration path; never overwrite an existing first-publication timestamp.
On rerun compare frozen identity/provenance/hashes and preserve existing matches. Reject collisions; never clear unrelated tables or regenerate IDs.
Avatar-candidate media are supporting input assets, not primary content. No account avatar is changed by this manifest.
